en.headline: Three men arrested over Tai Wai claw machine theft of nearly 100 toys
en.dek: Police said the men, aged 28 to 33, are suspected of stealing plush toys worth about HK$70,000 from a self-service shop on 17 September and handling the stolen goods.
body: Three local men aged 28 to 33 have been arrested in connection with the theft of nearly 100 plush toys valued at about HK$70,000 from a self-service claw machine shop in Tai Wai, police said on Friday.

Sha Tin District anti-triad officers said the break-in occurred in the early hours of 17 September at a shop on Tsuen Nam Road. Two suspects used a metal bar to force open two machines, stuffed the toys into bags and fled in a getaway vehicle before transferring the goods to other cars.

Investigators reviewed closed-circuit television footage, identified the suspects and vehicles, and arrested the men, including the alleged ringleader and getaway driver, in Sha Tin. Some of the stolen toys were later recovered from other claw machine shops in the district. The investigation continues.

zh.headline: 大圍夾公仔店失竊近百隻公仔 警拘三男
zh.dek: 警方指三名28至33歲男子涉嫌於9月17日凌晨撬開兩部夾公仔機，偷去市值約7萬元公仔及處理贓物。
body: 警方周五表示，已拘捕三名28至33歲本地男子，涉嫌與大圍一間自助夾公仔店失竊近百隻、市值約7萬元公仔案有關。
沙田警區反三合會行動組稱，案件於9月17日凌晨發生，兩名疑犯以鐵筆撬開村南道一間店舖兩部夾公仔機，將公仔裝入膠袋後乘車逃去，並將贓物轉交其他車輛處理。
人員翻查閉路電視鎖定相關人士及車輛，先後在沙田區拘捕三人，包括案中主腦及接應車手，並於區內其他夾公仔店起回部分失物。案件仍在調查中。
